verdict.rationale: Framer's first-party docs describe a built-in AI agent that creates editable pages, sections, copy and visuals from a prompt. It also edits existing designs on request, including site-wide styling, responsive breakpoint adaptation and interactive elements, with refinement continuing in conversation or on the canvas. This covers first drafts, layouts and full mockups, but all evidence is vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Framer’s AI agent creates editable pages, sections, copy, and visuals directly in your project. Keep refining in the conversation, or take over on the canvas at any point.
Start from a prompt and use the Framer canvas to refine layouts, typography, components, breakpoints, spacing, color, and effects.
Describe the look you want. The agent takes care of colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects across your site.
It adapts your layouts across breakpoints, adjusting stacks, type sizes, spacing, and image crops until everything works.
Sticky navbars, animated menus, interactive carousels, just describe what you want. The agent handles the wiring so you can focus on the design, not the how-to.
